items.title: Igaratinga (MG) Education procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 18 #03
items.en_title: Igaratinga (MG) Education procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 18 #03
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Igaratinga (MG) is procuring education-related goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 157,440; proposals close Nov 18, 08:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
